name: Admin Client Document-Signed Notification
description: When a client click-to-accept signs a document (POST /api/accounts/documents/:uuid/sign/), notify_team_document_signed_task fires a team milestone alert (in-app to project admins + email) and the client receives a signature-confirmation email. Best-effort; idempotent re-signs do not re-notify.
knownGaps: Server-triggered side-effect (in-app + email). Out of browser-E2E scope; may be asserted as a branch of platform-client-document-sign.
